includes: Fishing licenses, rods, tackle, bait, and fuel

blurb: Guests fish inshore around inlets, bridges, docks, and mangroves targeting a variety of species including tarpon, red drum, snook, and more. Offshore trips target deep sea species like mahi mahi, tuna, and grouper. Captain Bruno provides all fishing licenses, rods, tackle, bait, and fuel, and fillets all legal fish for guests to take home.
